Owning Browser access, remote Project enrollment, or remote execution runtimes.
Owning a second Workbench product UI separate from apps/web.
Choosing product quit, Panel-close, retention, or confirmation policy and presentation.
Interpreting Server wire messages, persisting Session state, or activating Desktop updates.
